blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Space Agency (PhilSA) on Monday warned the public about suspected rocket debris in Philippine waters near Palawan, following another rocket launch in China. According to PhilSA, China’s Long March 12 rocket was launched from the Hainan International Commercial Launch Center in Wenchang, Hainan, at around 4:24 a.m. READ: PhilSA moves
